verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms that https://www.rudderstack.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a RudderStack-specific summary, so an agent can be pointed at it directly. The official MCP server also lets agents ask questions about RudderStack features and get answers with source citations, which serves as an agent-oriented docs channel. Missing for 10: per-page markdown doc variants (the docs .md probe returned 404), evidence of how deep or broad the llms.txt content is, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agents using it.
